title: Current sense against clamp
finding: At 80 percent throttle the sense reading was 11.6 A against 32.4 A on the clamp; at 100 percent, 64.7 A against 55.7 A.

caveats.text: The clamp zero offset in this capture, about -0.4 A, is not removed, so the 15 percent point is not reliable.
The clamp is reference grade below 40 A; the 100 percent point is above that.
The ESC trace is a bench controller ADC value at a set gain, not a reading from the ESC firmware.
No capture exists after the rev3.2 input network change, so whether it removed the error is not known.

reduction: Median over the settled window of each throttle hold; the band is the 25th to 75th percentile.

series.label: Clamp meter, battery lead, hold median
